name: M.O.D.O.K.

abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Steadfast: Aktifken, Unblockable saldırılar sanki değillermiş gibi bloklanabilir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Her dövüşe aktif güç alanıyla başlar (%100 otomatik blok+siper, 8sn'de bir), isabetli saldırı ve kesin isabeti engeller. Abalo (impact) efektli şampiyonlar (Vox, Scream, Gorr) otomatik bloğu tamamen yok sayar; kesin-isabetli şampiyonlar (Mole Man, Medusa, Bullseye, Attuma) da yok sayar. Sanar veya sersemletme-immün şampiyonlar (Chee'ilth, Lumatrix, Baron Zemo) sorunu küçültür.
signatureAbility:
Master Plan
M.O.D.O.K.'s personal Debuffs gain [15-60]% increased Ability Accuracy.
When M.O.D.O.K. is attacked while the Force Field is active, he removes all Stun effects on himself. Personal Auto-Blocks are considered Well-Timed Blocks and can trigger the Parry Mastery.
When the Opponent activates a Special Attack, M.O.D.O.K. removes all of their True Strike and True Sense effects.

abilitySections.title: Flux Passive
content: M.O.D.O.K.'s attributes fluctuate throughout the fight in a complex and seemingly unpredictable manner. It would take a super-genius to calculate the pattern…
Up to +[12,201.6] Attack Rating.
Up to +[1,069.44] Block Proficiency.
Up to +[1,685.48] Critical Damage.
Up to +40% Combat Power Rate.
Up to 100% increased Defensive Ability Accuracy.
Reduce the Ability Accuracy of Opponent's True Strike and True Sense effects by 50%, up to 100%.

abilitySections.title: Force Field Passive
content: M.O.D.O.K. starts each fight with a Force Field active. When removed or caused to fail, it goes on cooldown for 8 seconds, then reactivates. If fighting a Skill Champion, the Force Field starts on cooldown.
The Force Field's Ability Accuracy cannot be reduced, unless fighting a Skill Champion.
While the Force Field is active, M.O.D.O.K. gains +[239.13] Block Proficiency and has a 100% chance to Auto-Block incoming attacks. Triggering this Auto-Block removes the Force Field.
While the Force Field is active, the Opponent's Ability Power Rate is reduced by up to 100% based on Flux.
As a Defender, the Force Field also grants a Steadfast Passive.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: M.O.D.O.K.'s Critical Rating is set to 0, and cannot be increased by outside sources.
Every 7th hit gains +[11,000] Critical Rating. If triggered during a Special Attack, the bonus persists for the rest of the Special.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Each hit has a 50% chance to inflict an Incinerate Debuff dealing [6,100.8] Energy Damage over 4 seconds. Max stacks: 8.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: During each hit, the Opponent's current Combat Power Rate is reduced by 100%.
During this attack, the Opponent suffers -250% Ability Power Rate and Regeneration Rate.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit has a 60% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff dealing [6,100.8] Direct Damage over 6 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
Bleed duration is increased by up to 100% based on Flux.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Each rocket has an 80% chance to inflict one of the following Debuffs:
Bleed dealing [6,100.8] Direct Damage over 8 seconds.
Incinerate dealing [6,100.8] Energy Damage over 4 seconds.
[305.56] Fatigue for 12 seconds.
[126.57] Exhaustion for 9 seconds.
A 6 second Weakness with 45% potency.
Poison dealing [7,626] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.
Heal Block for 7 seconds.
85% Concussion for 11 seconds.
